title: holding_feature
_what: ⛔ SNG-658 §2 — ONE THING BUILT ON A HOLDING: a wall, a watch, a mill, a shrine. ⚠️ `craftIds` is present on 44 of 44 and EMPTY on all 44 — the gap Aevi names in §1 and the reason SNG-658 exists: a field declared, written, and never filled.
_derivedFrom: The live saves, 2026-09-26; each field's description says how often it is present.

^_._what: a note or a provenance stamp

kind.description: 100% — which feature it is; the key into the authored catalogue.

family.description: 100% — martial · industry · meaning … what sort of thing it is.

name.description: 100% — what this one is called at this place.

craftIds.description: 100% present, EMPTY on all 44 — ⛔ the crafts that made it. This is the `craftIds: []` gap: the contract was right and nothing ever filled it, which is the lesson SNG-658 §4 ends on.

count.description: 100% — how many of it stand here.

site.description: SNG-679 H6 (CCODE-679): where it stands on its hold's own local map — within the rung's `siteRadiusMetres` of the hold's centre (or a `scatter` deck's length), placed once on first draw and STORED so it never jumps.

level.description: the rung it has been raised to, 1–3. Absent means 1.

building.description: set while it is still going up — a feature under construction does not watch, defend or cost keep. ⚠️ DECLARED `boolean` until 2026-09-30 and written as an OBJECT since the build system shipped: `addFeature` records what is still owed and how many passes are left, and `tickStore` pays it down from the store each pass. Nothing ever carried a boolean here; the census only caught it the day Erik started a barracks, because the field does not exist until somebody builds something.

owed.description: goods still to be found, by kind — emptied as the store pays it off.

passesLeft.description: passes of work remaining; it stands when this and `owed` are both clear.

paid.description: what it has already cost — `store` by good, and `coin`.

via.description: 11% — how it came to be here, when it was not simply built.
